caption: The video showcases a large faceted crystal sphere with an internal crackle structure flashing iridescent rainbow colors, resting on a small metallic pedestal. The pedestal has a cylindrical lower base and an upper disc from which three short vertical prongs rise to cradle the sphere's lower edge. The object sits on a pale circular tabletop against a plain neutral gray wall. Throughout the clip the upper assembly turns steadily about a vertical axis, the visible prongs drifting horizontally around the lower rim while the sphere's center holds position. The internal faceted pattern and bright highlights continuously reorganize and sweep across the volume as different facets face the camera. Dark reflective crescents on the left and right sides change size and position as the sphere turns. The metal base, gray background, and tabletop edge remain stationary, consistent with object rotation rather than camera movement.
